notes:
v1.0.87 - Spotify removed, your MP3s everywhere & a mini player in the title bar:
1) SPOTIFY IS GONE: the whole connection (UI, login flow, Web Playback SDK, tokens, settings) was removed - your music library is 100% local now.
2) YOUR OWN MUSIC AT MAX: the local MP3 library runs on a single shared player engine with true pause/resume (keeps position), previous/next, shuffle, repeat off/all/one and volume. Tracks auto-advance when they finish, and if there is no next track the same one plays again - the music never stops. Re-selecting the current track restarts it from the beginning.
3) MINI PLAYER IN THE TITLE BAR: Play/Pause and Next buttons plus the current track name right next to the Reimagined logo at the top of the window. Always in sync with the Settings music panel (the track name hides on narrow windows so window controls never get crowded).
